response.text: I see hackathons as the ultimate competitive sport for engineers! They force you to learn a new technology under intense pressure, collaborate with a team, and ship a functional product in 48 hours. It's the fastest way to go from zero to one on a new skill. Plus, nothing solidifies knowledge like building something real with tight deadlines. The adrenaline rush of shipping under pressure is addictive!
response.voiceText: Hackathons are my competitive sport! They force you to learn fast, build under pressure, and ship in 48 hours. It's the fastest way to master new skills.
